result.instructions: Tools for ClassMarker, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show test results from my groups that were finished in the past week."; "Which groups, links and exams do I have set up for online tests?"; "What questions are currently in my question bank, first page?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ClassMarker data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run classmarker_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run classmarker_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run classmarker_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. classmarker_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: classmarker_list_groups_links_exams
tools.title: List groups, links and exams
tools.description: List the groups, links and exams (tests) this API key can access, with the ids the other tools need (group_id, link_id, link_url_id, test_id, and access_list_id for links with an access-code list). Good first call. Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: GET /v1.json.

tools.name: classmarker_recent_group_results
tools.title: Recent results across all groups
tools.description: Recent finished test results taken in the key's groups (all groups, all exams), oldest first, PAGED by finish time: test-taker name, email, score, percentage, pass/fail, timing, certificate. Contains personal data: use small pages. Max look-back 3 months. Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: GET /v1/groups/recent_results.json.

finished_after_timestamp.description: UNIX time in SECONDS: only results finished after this are returned (oldest first). Default: 14 days ago. Maximum look-back is 3 months. To page, pass next_finished_after_timestamp from the previous reply.

limit.description: Results per request, 1-200 (default 25; ClassMarker's own default is 200).

include_monitor_events.description: Include each result's detailed monitor_events.events list (default false: only the counts).

tools.name: classmarker_recent_link_results
tools.title: Recent results across all links
tools.description: Recent finished test results taken through the key's links (all links, all exams), oldest first, PAGED by finish time: test-taker name, email, score, pass/fail, timing, access code, extra tracking fields, IP address, certificate. Contains personal data: use small pages. Max look-back 3 months. Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: GET /v1/links/recent_results.json.

finished_after_timestamp.description: UNIX time in SECONDS: only results finished after this are returned (oldest first). Default: 14 days ago. Maximum look-back is 3 months. To page, pass next_finished_after_timestamp from the previous reply.

limit.description: Results per request, 1-200 (default 25; ClassMarker's own default is 200).

include_monitor_events.description: Include each result's detailed monitor_events.events list (default false: only the counts).

Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: GET /v1/groups/{group_id}/tests/{test_id}/recent_results.json.

finished_after_timestamp.description: UNIX time in SECONDS: only results finished after this are returned (oldest first). Default: 14 days ago. Maximum look-back is 3 months. To page, pass next_finished_after_timestamp from the previous reply.

limit.description: Results per request, 1-200 (default 25; ClassMarker's own default is 200).

tools.name: classmarker_list_categories
tools.title: List question categories
tools.description: List the question-bank categories with their parent categories and ids (needed for creating and updating questions). Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: GET /v1/categories.json.

tools.name: classmarker_list_questions
tools.title: List question-bank questions
tools.description: List the questions of the question bank, 200 per page (page 1, 2, ...): question text, type, category, points, options, correct options, status. A full page means more may follow, so ask for the next page. Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: GET /v1/questions.json?page=N.

tools.name: classmarker_get_question
tools.title: Get a question
tools.description: Get one question-bank question by id (ids from classmarker_list_questions). Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: GET /v1/questions/{question_id}.json.

tools.name: classmarker_add_access_codes
tools.title: Add access codes to a list
tools.description: WRITE: add access codes (1-100 per call, up to 255 characters each; a list holds at most 20,000) to a link's access-code list, so those people can start the exam. The access_list_id comes from classmarker_list_groups_links_exams (links[].access_list_id). Only adds; removing codes is not offered. Does not count against the 30 requests per hour limit. API: POST /v1/accesslists/{access_list_id}.json.

annotations.title: Add access codes to a list

tools.name: classmarker_create_parent_category
tools.title: Create a parent category
tools.description: WRITE: create a new top-level question category. Returns its parent_category_id. Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: POST /v1/categories/parent_category.json.

parent_category_name.description: Name of the new parent category.

tools.name: classmarker_update_parent_category
tools.title: Rename a parent category
tools.description: WRITE: rename an existing parent category (overwrites its name). Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: PUT /v1/categories/parent_category/{parent_category_id}.json.

tools.name: classmarker_create_category
tools.title: Create a category
tools.description: WRITE: create a question category under a parent category. Returns its category_id. Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: POST /v1/categories/category.json.

tools.name: classmarker_update_category
tools.title: Update a category
tools.description: WRITE: rename a category and/or move it to another parent (overwrites both fields: send the name and parent_category_id you want it to have). Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: PUT /v1/categories/category/{category_id}.json.

parent_category_id.description: The parent category id (new or unchanged).

tools.name: classmarker_create_question
tools.title: Create a question
tools.description: WRITE: add a new question to the question bank. Only multiplechoice, multipleresponse, truefalse and essay can be created. Returns the new question_id. For truefalse, give only correct_options ["A"] (True) or ["B"] (False). Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: POST /v1/questions.json.

question_type.description: multiplechoice (one correct option), multipleresponse (one or more), truefalse, or essay (graded by hand). Free text, grammar and matching cannot be written.

points.description: Points for a correct answer (for an essay: the maximum score).

options.description: Answer options keyed by letter A-J (up to 10), e.g. {"A": "Apply oil", "B": "Soak in water"}. Needed for multiplechoice and multipleresponse; not allowed for truefalse and essay.

correct_options.description: Letters of the correct options, e.g. ["C"]. multiplechoice: exactly one; multipleresponse: one or more; truefalse: ["A"] (True) or ["B"] (False); not allowed for essay.

random_answers.description: Shuffle the order of the options for each test-taker (multiplechoice / multipleresponse).

grade_style.description: multipleresponse only: partial credit with or without deduction, or off (all-or-nothing).

correct_feedback.description: Feedback shown for a correct answer.

incorrect_feedback.description: Feedback shown for an incorrect answer.

tools.name: classmarker_update_question
tools.title: Update a question
tools.description: WRITE (overwrites): replace an existing question-bank question. Send the COMPLETE question (type, text, options, correct options, points, feedback), not only the changed fields; read it first with classmarker_get_question. Only multiplechoice, multipleresponse, truefalse and essay questions can be updated. Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: PUT /v1/questions/{question_id}.json.
